$comment: The current oracle pin (specs/conformance/dsl.md D11): anki version, sha256 of oracle/requirements.lock, and sha256 of oracle/macos/requirements-macos.lock for the macOS native lane (float-determinism.md F6.1). Goldens recorded with another lock_sha256 are stale; overlays recorded with another macos_lock_sha256 are stale. Change it only when adopting an oracle bump, together with both lock files, every golden and every overlay.
